issues.title: Marker missing for edit orders
issues.body:
@lebaphi created a fix for showing the geoman marker for drawing  new points.

When we edit an existing shape, it doesn't show an marker - the icon isn't found.

I've tried to [copy](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2033/commits/78f667a12ecbf87f2e7a78403d5d555099d8b56e) the code, but it still doesn't work.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/200938014-9b793104-4209-40e3-b505-76eeefd09068.mp4


Steps to reproduce:
* open storybook:  https://serge-sql.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-organisms-planningchannel--default
* open `orders` tab
* expand to view all rows
* find row with `point` in the `Activity`
* expand the row
* click on the `Edit` button in `Location`
* you'll see the marker isn't present
